title: Spanish-Style Vegetable Fritters
description: Crispy vegetable fritters with a Spanish twist, served as a snack or as a side dish. These fritters are made with a variety of vegetables and a blend of Spanish spices.
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Mix together the chopped vegetables, pisto, manchego, tempting, toasty, and spanish in a bowl.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry until the fritters are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve hot with a side of your favorite chutney or sauce.
Note: If you want to bake the fritters instead of frying, preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and bake for 15-20 minutes.
